newsitem.title: USA: Raleigh sports authority signs arena lease - paper.
newsitem.headline: Raleigh sports authority signs arena lease - paper.

text.p: The bonding authority for Raleigh's new sports arena approved a lease agreement with North Carolina State University, News & Observer reported Tuesday.
The Centennial Authority approved the agreement 7-6 Monday, clearing the way for the university's basketball teams to play in the $132 million arena beginning in 1999.
The arena will also house the Carolina Hurricanes professional hockey team.
The lease with the university calls for it to pay at least $600,000 in annual rent and gives the school naming rights and a share of arena revenues.

Wake County and the City of Raleigh have pledged $48 million of hotel bed tax revenues for the arena. The Centennial Authority plans to issue up to $57 million of tax-exempt bonds for the facility by the end of the year.
